messages:
Sam (Sales): Hey team — just received a SIG/CAIQ + custom security questionnaire from HelioPay. Procurement wants answers by Tue 2026-03-24. Can security own triage? There are a few policy/KMS/network items that will need eng and SE input. Quick summary: 1) KMS separation / HSM ask, 2) dedicated instance question, 3) data retention and tokenization Qs. I attached the bundle below.

Natalie (Security): Thanks Sam — please drop the doc link here and I'll pick it up for triage. Who is the contact there?

Sam (Sales): Link uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/heliopay/qna (shared). Contact is mikael@heliopay.com. FYI they called out dedicated instance + KMS separation as deal breakers.

security-bot: New ticket created: SEC-4321 — HelioPay questionnaire intake. Assignee: unassigned. Priority: high. https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-4321

Jordan P (SE): I can draft the tech responses for deployment/KMS. Please add me to the drive share (I still see view-only). Also want to confirm model-of-use: are they storing any PII in prompt/history? Sam?

Sam (Sales): They said payment chat transcripts will contain last4 and sometimes email; they asked about redaction/PII controls. I told them we'd handle redaction + retention policy.

Alex K (Eng): For KMS/HSM: hosted supports per-customer KMS keys (Cloud KMS) but not HSM-backed in hosted tier. HSM would require Dedicated/Private or customer-managed HSM integration. Natalie — do we have a short blurb to paste?

Natalie (Security): Assigning ownership now. Plan: split SIG and CAIQ, SE to draft deployment answers, Eng to confirm infra-specifics. Jordan — take sections 5-10 (deployment, keys, encryption). Alex — take section 11 (networking, VPC, firewall). Sam — confirm procurement timeline and SOC2 evidence.

Sam (Sales): Confirmed: procurement requires SOC2 + risk matrix. I uploaded our SOC2 report to the drive.

Jordan P (SE): I added draft responses to sections 5-10 and marked a few TODOs where I need an architecture diagram and exact KMS wording. @Alex K can you drop a simplified network diagram (png) in the drive?

Alex K (Eng): Will add diagram by EOD. Note for the docs: if they require HSM we need to propose Private deployment and quote integration.

Natalie (Security): Creating an assignment checklist and scheduling a triage call with HelioPay for tomorrow 10am PT. @Sam can you invite and include mikael + legal procurement? I'll post the assignment after the call.

---
```
Assignment:
- ticket: SEC-4321
- owner_security: Natalie (Security)
- assignees: Jordan P (SE), Alex K (Eng)
- due_by: 2026-03-24
- status: triage_open
- docs: https://drive.redwood/heliopay/qna
```

security-bot: Reminder: SEC-4321 due in ~2 days. Please update ticket with answers or escalate.

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: Invite sent to HelioPay + procurement. I'll paste meeting notes here after call.

Jordan P (SE): If HSM/Private is required we'll flag pricing impact — rough delta +$20k/mo for Dedicated + integration one-time.

Natalie (Security): Noted. For now marking status as in_progress once we have initial draft.

security-bot: Ticket SEC-4321 status changed to in_progress by Natalie (Security).

Sam (Sales): I'll update this thread after the triage call. Thanks everyone.
